**⟫ New Ores,Tools,Armors,Machines, All centered around the Frost.**
<details>
<summary>Overview</summary>
  
- Step into a harsh world shaped by frost and ancient ice magic. FrostBound invites you to venture beyond simple survival, exploring vast cold biomes where only the strongest endure. Discover the rare Glacium Ore, unlock magical artifacts, and harness the power of frost to craft powerful gear and mysterious items.

- Wander through frozen shrines lost to time, haunted by chilling creatures adapted to the cold. Face the unpredictable threats of the Creatures, and push onward as you build relics infused with long frozen fur and enchanted wood that pulse with icy energy.

- Every tool, staff, and armor piece you forge carries the Cold. With each breakthrough, you push further into the frozen unknown—into a world where cold is both adversary and ally. Can you rise above the freeze?


</details>
